name: update_gift_brief
description: Merge newly learned facts into the current GiftBrief. Call whenever the user reveals stable facts about the occasion, recipient, interests, personality, memories, tone, assets, budget or deadline.

patch.description: Partial GiftBrief object. Only include facts actually supported by the conversation.

name: get_gift_brief
description: Read the current structured GiftBrief before deciding what information is still missing.

name: show_products
description: Show at most three relevant MythicBee products in the page UI once enough context exists to make the choices meaningful.

name: show_example
description: Reveal one specific example that helps the customer understand a creative direction or product.

name: fly_to
description: Move Bartholomew next to a known page element. Use sparingly to guide attention, not continuously.

name: point_at
description: Have Bartholomew visibly point toward a known page element.

name: set_expression
description: Set Bartholomew's expression/state. Use reactions that fit the conversation and do not over-animate.

name: request_upload
description: Open the appropriate upload UI only when media would materially improve the concept or is required to proceed.

name: create_concept
description: Generate a concise creative concept from the current GiftBrief when the brief is sufficiently complete.

name: create_preview
description: Start generation of a customer-visible preview using the selected product and current GiftBrief. This may spend compute and should only happen after the UI obtains user confirmation.

name: add_to_cart
description: Prepare a selected product for the cart. The client must show an explicit confirmation step before any purchase or charge.
